2607.24280.title: From Proprietary to Open-Source: Bridging the Distribution Gap via Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation in Agentic Search
2607.24280.paper_summary: Agentic search enables large language models to solve knowledge-intensive tasks by interleaving multi-step reasoning with retrieval, yet optimizing this with outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides only sparse supervision. Knowledge distillation can supply denser guidance, and advanced proprietary models with their strong reasoning capabilities are promising teachers. While distilling from proprietary models can densify this supervisory signal, conventional logit-matching is precluded by hidden logits and mismatched tokenizers, whereas raw natural language trajectory imitation transfers superficial stylistic artifacts rather than core reasoning competence. To address the heterogeneous distillation problem and bridge the distribution gap, we propose Multi-Agent Protocol Distillation (MAPD), a joint distillation and RL framework uses a structured, style-normalized protocol as an intermediate representation. An offline multi-agent system (MAS) decomposes each query, retrieves supporting evidence, repairs failed searches, and converts the resulting exploration trace into a JSON protocol containing the task type, reasoning plan, and extractive grounding facts. During training, the protocol is provided only to a privileged branch of the student policy, whose token distributions furnish a dense distillation signal alongside the sparse RL objective. Extensive evaluations across seven QA benchmarks demonstrate that MAPD consistently outperforms competitive distillation and RL, achieving average success rates of 39.4\% on Qwen3-1.7B and 44.4\% on Qwen3-4B. Crucially, the framework generalizes robustly across diverse proprietary teachers while effectively mitigating the student policy from style drift and verbosity degeneration.
2607.24280.paper_summary_zh: 代理搜索使大型語言模型能夠通過交錯多步推理與檢索來解決知識密集型任務，然而，通過基於結果的強化學習（RL）來優化這一點僅提供稀疏的監督。知識蒸餾可以提供更密集的指導，而具有強大推理能力的先進專有模型則是有前途的教師。雖然從專有模型中蒸餾可以使這一監督信號變得更密集，但傳統的邏輯匹配受到隱藏邏輯和不匹配的標記器的限制，而原始自然語言軌跡模仿則轉移了表面的風格特徵，而不是核心推理能力。為了解決異質蒸餾問題並彌合分佈差距，我們提出了多代理協議蒸餾（MAPD），這是一個聯合蒸餾和強化學習框架，使用結構化、風格標準化的協議作為中介表示。離線多代理系統（MAS）對每個查詢進行解構，檢索支持證據，修復失敗的搜索，並將結果探索痕跡轉換為包含任務類型、推理計劃和提取基礎事實的JSON協議。在訓練過程中，該協議僅提供給學生政策的特權分支，其標記分佈提供了密集的蒸餾信號，並伴隨著稀疏的RL目標。在七個QA基準上的廣泛評估表明，MAPD始終優於競爭性的蒸餾和RL，在Qwen3-1.7B上達到39.4\%的平均成功率，在Qwen3-4B上達到44.4\%。關鍵是，該框架在多樣化的專有教師之間具有穩健的泛化能力，同時有效減輕學生政策的風格漂移和冗長退化。
